title: Back To Nature
description: Makes Minecraft just a bit more focused on Nature!
body:
This Mod makes Minecraft focus just a bit more on nature!

# Features
### Blocks
- Untidy Basket
- Vitalizer
- Wooden Battery
- Wildlife Beacon
- Lumberjack Table
### Items
- Lumberjack Axe (Wood, Stone, Iron...)
### Entities
- Sparrow
- Lumberjack Villager
### Structures
- Fireplace
